name: Peter Pan's Flight

attributes.description: A beloved suspended dark ride that sails guests in a pirate galleon over a miniature nighttime London and on to Never Land.

sources.title: Magic Kingdom Attractions and Rides | Walt Disney World Resort

needs_verification: One of the most consistently high-demand rides in Magic Kingdom despite no height requirement; typical stand-by waits can rival thrill rides — worth flagging for a wait-time-aware recommendation engine.
